name: Every caller shares one timeout constant
prompt: The request timeout is defined in three different modules (src/api.js, src/worker.js, src/upload.js) and the values have drifted apart. Make there be ONE definition of the request timeout — a new module src/timeout.js exporting REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS — and have all three modules import it, deleting their own copies. Do not modify files under test/. Existing tests must keep passing.
